title: Phodopus first-release remediation task graph (review 2026-09-20)

consequences: Consumers must build from the tagged source (cargo build --locked --release --workspace) rather than pulling a crates.io crate, until gc-arena publishes a compatible release and the crates are intentionally made publishable. cargo package --list --workspace --allow-dirty is the supported packaging verification; cargo package/publish full verification is intentionally omitted and documented in release.toml. The next milestone release should be tagged v0.2.0-alpha.1 and later v0.2.0.
context: PHO-004: Git tag and release v0.1.0 shipped while the workspace and both crates declared 0.1.0-alpha.1; the release had no assets; cargo package from the tagged tree failed because gc-arena is a git-only dependency; CHANGELOG.md had only inherited Piccolo entries. The review treats v0.1.0 as a Phase 1/1.5 development release and the next milestone is v0.2.0 (GH Issue #32 milestone).
decision_body: Adopt forward-aligned versioning on the v0.2.0 line: workspace and both crates are 0.2.0-alpha.1, the tag convention is v<version>, and the release title is v<version> - <summary>; the published v0.1.0 tag is left untouched because tags are immutable. Adopt a source-only (non-registry) distribution model: phodopus and phodopus-util set publish = false, and release verification builds from the tagged tree and attaches a deterministic source archive plus checksums. release.toml records the policy; .github/workflows/release.yml enforces version identity and produces the assets.
rationale: The registry gc-arena 0.5.3 (published 2024-05-15) predates the pinned revision 5a7534b883b703f23cfb8c3cfdf033460aa77ea9 (2024-07-23) despite sharing the version number, and is API-incompatible (cargo check reports 210 errors, e.g. unresolved gc_arena::Static and unsatisfied Collect). Adding a registry version would therefore produce an unbuildable, misleading tarball; marking the crates non-publishable and shipping tagged source is the only honest reproducible model. Moving forward to the 0.2.0 pre-release aligns every identity carrier without rewriting an immutable published tag.
title: Release identity and source-only distribution model for Phodopus
